purpose: Original short game announcements, not sampled from a commercial game

encoding.resample: 33-tap Hamming-windowed sinc low-pass, cutoff 0.215 cycles/source-sample; 2:1 decimation
encoding.trim: outer samples below 140 signed16, retain 10 ms lead and 20 ms tail
encoding.native_codec: PVSnesLib 4.6.0 SMConv BRR, gaussian native DSP interpolation

rights_and_provenance.procedural_cues: Original project-authored synthesis code; project license applies
rights_and_provenance.system_voice: Microsoft Windows Zira system voice; no engine, phoneme database, or voice-model files redistributed
rights_and_provenance.retained_files: Only newly exported project utterance PCM output is retained; no third-party game samples or commercial soundtrack
rights_and_provenance.review: Human listening and project public-use/consent gates remain separate; this is technical provenance, not a legal certification
